issues.legal_issue: A court exercising writ jurisdiction must consider material orders of a competent civil court and reports concerning the effect of a pending civil suit before directing possession to be transferred.
A legal proceeding brought on behalf of a Gram Sabha must be supported by a resolution of the Gram Sabha when the law requires such a resolution.
A writ petition brought without the required Gram Sabha resolution cannot be maintained as a proceeding on behalf of the Gram Sabha.
A court considering whether to treat a petition brought in an individual capacity as a public interest litigation must determine whether such litigation is appropriate in a private dispute.
